0: Osip brings the candle. Khlestakov seals the letter with sealing wax. At that moment Derzhimorda's voice is heard saying: "Where are you going, whiskers? You've been told that nobody is allowed to come in." KHLESTAKOV [giving the letter to Osip]. There, have it mailed.
1: MERCHANT'S VOICE. Let us in, brother. You have no right to keep us out. We have come on business.
2: DERZHIMORDA'S VOICE. Get out of here, get out of here! He doesn't receive anybody. He's asleep.
4: KHLESTAKOV. What's the matter there, Osip? See what the noise is about.
5: OSIP [looking through the window]. There are some merchants there who want to come in, and the sergeant won't let them. They are waving papers. I suppose they want to see you.
6: KHLESTAKOV [going to the window]. What is it, friends?
7: MERCHANT'S VOICE. We appeal for your protection. Give orders, your Lordship, that our petitions be received.
8: KHLESTAKOV. Let them in, let them in. Osip, tell them to come in.
10: KHLESTAKOV [takes the petitions through the window, unfolds one of them and reads]. "To his most honorable, illustrious financial Excellency, from the merchant Abdulin...." The devil knows what this is! There's no such title.
